sam_k: Short ops sync for launch surge: main tasks = redirects, anchor/link equity, event+FAQ schema, UTMs -> CRM, meta A/B.
lia_w: I'll own anchor plan + internal banners. Target pages: top 50 by sessions. Keep anchors natural.
omar_k: I'll run redirects CSV and do smoke tests. Preserve query params for utm_* and avoid chains. Will post CSV.
nina_p: I'll handle UTMs & CRM mapping: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign -> SFDC campaign 'Launch Surge Q2'. Hidden field: original_landing.
seo-bot: Tip: stage JSON-LD with data-nosnippet, run staging crawl, then remove before publish. Also schedule post-publish redirect crawl.
sam_k: Redirect snippet (examples):
from,to,status
/old/llm-costs,/resources/launchsprint/llm-costs,301
/blog/old-benchmarks,/resources/launchsprint/benchmarks,301
/register,/events/launch-surge/register,302
lia_w: Anchor plan highlights: use keyword-focused anchors for benchmarks and llm-cost page; include one brand anchor per page to avoid stuffing. Add hub banner on product pages and docs.
omar_k: Rollout plan: deploy redirects in small batches, run redirect-checker, run canonical crawl, then flip /register 302->301 after 14 days. Schedule smoke test at flip.
nina_p: UTM scheme: utm_source=(organic_social|partner_email), utm_medium=(social|email), utm_campaign=launch_surge_q2. Map to SFDC fields: Campaign, SourceDetail, Landing_URL. I'll post mapping sheet.
seo-bot: Schedule reminders: staging crawl 2026-04-17T08:00Z, post-publish redirect audit 2026-04-22T09:00Z.
sam_k: Owners: redirects -> @omar_k, anchors -> @lia_w, UTMs -> @nina_p, schema/meta -> @sam_k. Publish owner = growth-marketing.
lia_w: I'll batch anchor PRs in groups of 25 pages to minimize churn.
omar_k: Will open GH PR with redirects CSV + rollout SOP by Thu AM.
nina_p: GTM + SFDC QA checklist coming tomorrow.
sam_k: Great — keep updates concise and paste PR/ticket links here. :white_check_mark:
